purpose: base v2 pack: 16 control points, 12 candidates, budget 700, max 3

rules.coordinates: bbox fractions (x = share of lon span, y = share of lat span), rounded to 6 decimals
rules.control_points: cp01..cp16: 4x4 grid, x=(i+0.5)/4, y=(j+0.5)/4, row j outer (south to north), i inner (west to east)
rules.weights: SYNTHETIC: cp k (1-based) weight = 1 + ((3*k) mod 5); a user priority, not residents
rules.candidates: c01..c12: x in (1/8,3/8,5/8,7/8) inner, y in (1/6,1/2,5/6) outer; kind=hypothetical
rules.costs: SYNTHETIC conditional units: candidate k cost = 100 + 50*((5*k) mod 7); not tenge, not an estimate
rules.base: budget 700, max_selected 3, coverage_radius_m 400 (analysis parameter, not a walking norm), required [], excluded [], selected_ids [c06, c07] (the two candidates nearest the bbox centre)

provenance.upstream: Overture Maps places 2026-09-23.1 via K10 package (round-3 results); not re-downloaded

source_copy.note: read-only copy of web/data.js records of this category; the source records are never modified

does_not_claim: costs are not real prices or an estimate
the optimum is only among the entered candidates, not the best plan for the city
straight-line distance in this slice only; no walking time, capacity or social benefit
